# HexPiece 2.9.9

Your two notes on the Light fruit. Not tested in game yet; the build and tests pass, and I rendered the new kick.

- **Light can't fly any more.** No double-tap-jump flight, no sprinting light flight: the only way through the air is Z. If an older
  version gave you flight, it is taken away. X (Yasakani no Magatama) still lifts you up and holds you there while it pours (as before
  2.9.7), but you can't fly about with it.
- **Z hitting someone is now the kick from your picture.** When the light meets a mob or player, you come out of the light with a
  flying kick into their chest. They're blasted far along the way the light was going, with a trail of light behind them (a heavy hit,
  9 damage), then knocked down and ragdolled where they land, for 5 seconds in all. You hang in the air facing them while it lands.
  Z ends there (before, the light passed straight through them).
